replaceLine.find: description: Trace a failing test, stack trace, or unexpected output to its root cause: reproduce the failure, bisect to the specific line or input, form one hypothesis at a time, and confirm the fix against the original reproduction. Use for red tests, crashed commands, wrong output, flaky behavior, and any bug report before proposing a fix.
replaceLine.text: description: Debug any technical failure to its ROOT CAUSE before proposing any fix — trigger words: 排查, 查根本原因, 找根因, debug, 崩了, 报错, 帮我查一下, red test, stack trace, crashed command, wrong output, flaky behavior, build/CI failure, or any bug report. Reproduce the failure, bisect to the specific line or input, form one hypothesis at a time, and confirm the fix against the original reproduction. Symptom fixes are failure.
